name: Home Owner's Resident Card

requirements.blocker_text: Must own a registered, habitable residence in The Bahamas, evidenced by a deed of conveyance and an International Landholding Certificate under the International Persons Landholding Act (Chapter 140).
requirements.fix_path: Purchase a qualifying habitable residence in The Bahamas.

requirements.blocker_text: Must demonstrate ownership of a primary residence outside The Bahamas (home insurance, mortgage documents, or tax certificate).
Must show proof of current Real Property Tax payment on the Bahamian residence.

evidence_required.document: Current Real Property Tax payment proof
Proof of primary home ownership outside The Bahamas

sources.title: Bahamas Immigration Department -- Home Owner Identification: International Persons Landholding Act (Chapter 140), $200 processing fee, requires proof of a habitable Bahamian residence, a primary home abroad, and current Real Property Tax payment; applicants should not be in-country during initial processing

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of the Bahamas' initial build. This is a residence-identification status for owners of a second/vacation home who maintain a primary residence elsewhere, NOT a route to work or long-term settlement -- work_rights and study_rights modelled as 'none' since the source describes it purely as home-owner identification rather than a general residence permit; no explicit stay-duration or work authorisation was found. Distinct from bs_permanent_residence_investment.json, which requires a much larger ($1M) investment specifically in real estate or bonds and confers full residence/work rights.
